description: Cancels a watch party made with create_watch_room: its countdown page and link stop working. Needs the organiser_key (or organiser_link) that create_watch_room returned, so only the organiser can cancel. A room that is already open carries on until everyone leaves. Cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

room_code.description: The 5-character room code. Not needed when organiser_link is given.

name: cancel_watch_party

code.description: Error code when ok is false.

ok.description: false when the call failed; then code says why.

title: Cancel a scheduled watch party
